title: Imp Jar Select 10K Pod Vape Kit
description: Introducing the Imp Jar Select Pod Vape Kit, a clever and compact vaping solution designed for ultimate convenience. This stylish device bridges the gap between disposables and refillable kits with its standout feature: a built-in storage compartment designed to hold a 10ml bottle of e-liquid (sold separately). This unique "2-in-1" design ensures your e-liquid is always attached to your device, making it easier than ever to top up on the go without carrying loose bottles. The kit is powered by a reliable rechargeable internal battery and features a clear battery life indicator to keep you informed. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, it comes with a 0.8ohm mesh pod that delivers a smooth, restricted draw rich in flavour—perfect for the double-concentrate Imp Jar Select Nic Salts. Operation is effortless with a simple draw-activation system, while the pod features a convenient top-fill mechanism that allows for mess-free refilling without removing the pod from the device. Compact, innovative, and available in a range of stylish colours, the Imp Jar Select Kit is the perfect travel companion for vapers who value simplicity and performance. We recommend using the following E-Liquids with this kit Imp Jar Select 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
